description: This file contains test cases for UI shell behavior on Windows and other platforms using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions like 'shouldUseShellForCommand' and 'assertSafeWindowsShellArgs' to ensure correct handling of shell command execution and argument safety.

methods.name: shouldUseShellForCommand
methods.description: Determines if the shell should be used for a given command on a specific platform, primarily to handle Windows-specific shell requirements.

methods.name: assertSafeWindowsShellArgs
methods.description: Validates the provided arguments intended for Windows shell commands to prevent injection of unsafe or malicious arguments.
